investigations.title: Process balance
investigations.question: Does the calibrated, time-aligned measurement of a process close its declared balance, and are the residuals consistent with the declared uncertainty?

investigations.title: Manufacturing cycle
investigations.question: Given acquired machine records, what state and dynamics do they support, which observation should come next, and do the residuals stay consistent?

investigations.title: Geometry and BIM
investigations.question: Do observed positions and quantities agree with the declared geometry and building model within their covariance?
